Data.Description: Initialize a new empty UiPath solution. Creates a directory named after the solution containing a .uipx manifest file with an empty Projects array, plus AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md briefing files that orient AI coding agents to the solution. Use 'solution projects add' to add projects afterward.

Arguments.Name: solutionName
Arguments.Description: Solution name or path. Creates a directory with this name containing a .uipx manifest file.

Examples.Description: Initialize a new empty UiPath solution

Data.NextSteps: Read /workspace/my-solution/AGENTS.md or /workspace/my-solution/CLAUDE.md to understand the solution lifecycle, project types that can be used inside a solution, and related uip command references.
